label: Grünheide, Germany: forest cleared for the Tesla factory
blurb: About 92 ha of pine forest felled in February 2020.

label: Rhodes, Greece: July 2023 wildfire
blurb: Copernicus EMS mapped 17,629 ha burnt from 18 July 2023.

label: Cape Town: April 2021 Table Mountain fire
blurb: Fire from 18 April 2021 that burnt about 600 ha of fynbos and buildings.

label: Austin, Texas: Tesla Gigafactory built on a gravel-pit site
blurb: Construction began in July 2020 on a former sand and gravel mine by the Colorado River.

label: Saddleworth Moor, England: June 2018 moorland fire
blurb: Moorland fire from 24 June 2018 that grew to about 8 km² by 27 June.

label: Lützerath, Germany: village and fields taken by the Garzweiler mine
blurb: The village was cleared from 11 January 2023 and excavated for lignite during 2023.

label: Hasankeyf, Turkey: old town flooded by the Ilısu reservoir
blurb: The Ilısu reservoir, filling since July 2019, reached the town in early January 2020.

label: Sindh, Pakistan: 2022 monsoon floods near Lake Manchar
blurb: Lake Manchar grew from 334 to 512 km² between 11 and 26 August 2022.

label: Richmond Park, London: nothing documented
blurb: A protected grassland with no documented change; a false-alarm check.

label: Jaú National Park, Brazil: nothing documented
blurb: Primary forest interior with no documented clearing; a false-alarm check.
